cases.scope: Lock-order refinement for two independent queue publishers and one predicate-rechecking waiter; all three waiter identities and both queue probe orders explored. Each publisher completes one publication and signal; the waiter probes each queue once. Positive characterizes source queue-unlock-before-unprotected-signal and a proposed protected signal after queue unlock, combined with proposed waiter M-to-Q predicate probes. Negative deliberately nests Q-to-M in the publisher and exposes a cycle; not a defect attributed to unchanged source. Publication is coherent, no chunk processing occurs under M, and role completion is finite. Progress is only critical-section completion, not full GC closure. Excludes actual queue contents, wait registration/notification reliability, multiple simultaneous waiters, arbitrary repeated publication, external lock sites, C weak memory, condition errors, resize, native acceptance and speedup.
